subject: Coordination: renewal & expansion demo — stakeholder gateways and timeboxing
messages:
From: Jared Cole <jared@evergreenhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Stone <lara.stone@evergreenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal + expansion demo — proposing stakeholder gateways & staggered windows

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Thanks again for the QBR last week — our leadership liked the high-level roadmap and want a focused follow-up: a 60–90 minute renewal + expansion demo for the core product and the new embeddings workflow. We have two constraints that make a single large meeting hard:

- Multiple executive stakeholders want a brief strategic overview only (20 min) before we hand off to product/engineering for the technical deep-dive.
- Procurement wants to be in the loop early — they ask for a short pre-demo alignment on contract milestones.

Proposal: two staggered windows on the same day (exec 20–30m / product 60m) with explicit "gateway" approvals between them so we can stop/continue based on exec feedback. Can Redwood own the run of show + calendar invites?

Ideal dates (PDT):
- Wed Aug 19 — exec 12:00–12:30 / product 12:45–13:45
- Thu Aug 20 — exec 10:00–10:30 / product 10:45–11:45

Attachments: MAP_draft_v2.pdf (mutual action plan, draft), run_of_show.xlsx (proposed cadence)

If those windows work, I can loop procurement (procurement@evergreenhealth.com) and confirm their availability.

Best,
Jared Cole
Director, Platform Partnerships
Evergreen Health

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 18:02:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion demo — proposing stakeholder gateways & staggered windows

Thanks Jared — appreciate the clarity. We can absolutely run the calendar orchestration and own the run of show. Quick notes / asks from our side:

1) Gateway definition: can you confirm who the "exec" approver will be (name + role)? We want a single explicit decision maker per session to avoid ambiguity.
2) Security/compliance prelim: do you want a 15-min pre-call with your InfoSec/procurement before the product session? We often do a 15m laundry list to surface SOC2 / data residency asks.
3) Headcount: how many people will join the product deep-dive (engineers/ML)? We need to set breakouts if >12.

I prefer Thu Aug 20 (10:00 / 10:45) to give our engineers one day to prepare after the exec pre-brief. I'll tentatively hold the slots and will send calendar invites once you confirm exec approver and procurement availability.

Proposed owner for run of show: Monica (I'll cc her) — Monica, can you review the attached run_of_show and add a short module on "quantized inference and cost controls"?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment: run_of_show.xlsx)
